liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Reviewer recommends the China Cat into Rider, saying Jerry played wildly [26]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Reviewer singles out Estimated Prophet as a highlight [33]
- **It's All Over Now Baby Blue** (1 review): Reviewer lists the Baby Blue encore as a standout [33]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): Reviewer calls this Wharf Rat among the best heard across more than 400 shows [33]

## Setlist highlights

- **Whar Rat**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [37]

## The recordings

- **gd84-04-19.aud.willy.14013.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 172 min; rated 3.54/5 by 13 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the first set is especially strong and the recording sounds good; Reviewer finds the audience tape tinny and stadium-like, with Phil's bass nearly missing from the mix [27][32]
- **gd84-04-19.sbd.19598.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 167 min; rated 4.73/5 by 11 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the hall's visuals were appealing but the sound quality was unremarkable; Reviewer describes the soundboard as great sounding [26][35]
- **gd1984-04-19.164735.senn441.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 19 songs; 167 min [8]
- **gd1984-04-19.aud.bandrofcheck.34680.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 173 min [10]. Said about its sound: Very little crowd noise has been removed from this audience recording [10]
- **gd1984-04-19.166575.mtx.seamons.ht164.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 163 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [13]. Said about its sound: In the matrix, the soundboard's first 1:25 of Bertha is boomy and flat; levels were reduced afterward [13]

## Around the show

- Taper says the hall had poor acoustics and that weekend shows were starting to sell out heavily, with many ticket seekers [25]
- Reviewer recalls odd acoustics in the venue and plenty of dancing space at the back along both sides [28]
- First set is high-energy with Jerry on fire; second set is very tight [29]
- Reviewer dislikes Brent's keyboard setting, which sounds like glockenspiel for most of the show [32]
- Reviewer without tickets was let past security along the building's side and entered through an open door, missing two songs [36]
- Reviewer remembers all three Philadelphia shows that run as fairly average [28]
- Reviewer says this show looks less impressive on paper than the following two Philadelphia nights, yet it is excellent [29]
- Dave's Picks Volume 35 is a three-CD release from the following night, Philadelphia 4/20/84 [42]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd84-04-19.aud.willy.14013.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD>MC>CD [1]. Also: Audience source transferred via MC to CD, passed along by Paul B and seeded to etree by Willy [1]
- **gd84-04-19.sbd.19598.sbeok.shnf**: source: Sbd > Cassette Master > Cassette > Dat x 2 > CDR > SHN Seeded to FurthurNET [5]
- **gd1984-04-19.164735.senn441.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Rob Eaton, Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Rob Eaton's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 441 mics > Sony D5M [8]
- **gd1984-04-19.aud.bandrofcheck.34680.sbeok.shnf**: source: unknown shotgun mics > Sony D6 > Maxell MX 90s (MC) > Marantz PRD505 (azimuth adjusted) > Marantz Intergrated Stereo Amp MP-68 > SBLive! > Audacity… [10]. Also: Cassette recording with no tape flips during recording; side A tapes recorded first, B sides after the break [10]
- **gd1984-04-19.166575.mtx.seamons.ht164.flac16**: source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut w/EQ > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging) December 24, 2023 [13]. Also: Matrix patches audience sections from Jeff Silberman's Sennheiser 441 DAT recording and fills cuts in Bertha and Space [13]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Steve Schneider Grateful Dead: [1984-04-20 Philadelphia Civic Arena, Philadelphia, PA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1984-04-20-philadelphia-civic-arena-philadelphia-pa-usa/) [38]
- Poster by Steve Schneider Grateful Dead: [1984-04-21 Philadelphia Civic Arena, Philadelphia, PA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1984-04-21-philadelphia-civic-arena-philadelphia-pa-usa/) [39]
- Fan art by RareVinyl.com: [Grateful Dead Dave's Picks Volume 35: Philadelphia Civic Center, Philadelphia, PA 4/20/84 2020 US 3-CD set](https://uk.rarevinyl.com/products/grateful-dead-dave-s-picks-volume-35-philadelphia-civic-center-philadelphia-pa-4-20-84-us-3-cd-album-triple-set-r2607317-790471) [43]
